title: MK inbound event v1
description: A customer message received through the enrolled sending identity's provider webhook. Recorded durably by the kernel BEFORE the provider is acknowledged. The body is sealed (content_reference points at it) and never appears in logs or audit metadata. Fields are exactly those the production completion contract requires.

provider_event_id.description: Provider message id (MessageSid); the durable dedupe key with provider.

source_destination.description: HMAC fingerprint of the customer's number; the raw number is never stored on the event.

authentication_result.description: Only verified events are recorded; failures are refused with 403 and never create a row.
